blocks.zh: 附錄 I-IV：eCTD 申請概覽、Module 3 對照、PFS 測試標準、化合物分類
blocks.en: Appendices I-IV: eCTD Submission Overview, Module 3 Mapping, PFS Test Standards, Compound Classification

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 瞭解預填充式注射器 (Prefilled Syringe, PFS) 相關資訊在 eCTD 各 Module 中的配置邏輯
blocks.en: Understand how prefilled syringe (PFS) information is distributed across the eCTD Modules

blocks.zh: 掌握 Module 3 (Quality) 中藥品-器材組合產品 (Combination Product) 各子節應放置之內容
blocks.en: Know what content belongs in each subsection of Module 3 (Quality) for a drug-device combination product

blocks.zh: 認識適用於 PFS 組合產品各元件之測試方法、標準與法規指引文件
blocks.en: Become familiar with the test methods, standards and regulatory guidance documents that apply to each component of a PFS combination product

blocks.zh: 理解可萃取物/溶出物 (Extractables/Leachables) 之化合物分類與毒理學關注閾值 (TTC) 體系
blocks.en: Understand the compound classification for extractables/leachables and the Threshold of Toxicological Concern (TTC) framework

blocks.zh: 15.0 Appendix I: Electronic Common Technical Document (eCTD) Application Submission Overview 15.0 附錄 I：電子通用技術文件（eCTD）申請提交概述
blocks.en: 15.0 Appendix I: Electronic Common Technical Document (eCTD) Application Submission Overview

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: eCTD (Electronic Common Technical Document，電子通用技術文件)：這是全球藥品監管送審的標準化格式，由 ICH 制定，將申請文件分為五大模組 (Module 1-5)。對於 PFS 這類組合產品 (Combination Product)，器材相關資訊必須有計畫地散布在各模組中。
blocks.en: eCTD (Electronic Common Technical Document): The standardized format for regulatory submissions of medicinal products worldwide, developed by ICH, which divides the application into five modules (Modules 1-5). For a combination product such as a PFS, device-related information must be deliberately distributed across the modules.

blocks.zh: MAF (Medical Device Master File，醫療器材主檔案)：器材製造商可提交 MAF 供審查機構參照，申請人無需揭露全部器材設計細節，僅需提供引用授權信 (Letter of Authorization)。
blocks.en: MAF (Medical Device Master File): A device manufacturer can submit an MAF for the reviewing authority to reference, so the applicant does not need to disclose every detail of the device design and only has to provide a Letter of Authorization.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 將 eCTD 想像成一棟「標準化檔案大樓」：Module 1 是大廳接待處（行政表單），Module 2 是總覽樓層（摘要），Module 3 是品質實驗室（藥品品質資料），Module 4 是動物研究中心，Module 5 是臨床試驗中心。PFS 組合產品的器材資訊就像有特殊需求的住戶，需要在多個樓層同時設有辦公空間。
blocks.en: Think of the eCTD as a "standardized filing building": Module 1 is the reception lobby (administrative forms), Module 2 is the overview floor (summaries), Module 3 is the quality laboratory (drug quality data), Module 4 is the animal research center, and Module 5 is the clinical trial center. The device information for a PFS combination product is like a tenant with special needs who must have office space on several floors at once.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: Module 4（非臨床研究）未在本表出現，因為 PFS 器材本身通常不需要額外動物實驗（但 ISO 10993 生物相容性測試資料可放在 Module 3）
blocks.en: Module 4 (nonclinical studies) does not appear in this table because the PFS device itself usually needs no additional animal studies (although ISO 10993 biocompatibility data can be placed in Module 3)

blocks.zh: 510(k) 是美國 FDA 對器材上市前通知的審查途徑，對組合產品而言，510(k) 級別的器材資訊通常放在 Module 1 或 3.2.R 區域
blocks.en: 510(k) is the FDA premarket notification pathway for devices in the US; for a combination product, 510(k)-level device information is usually placed in Module 1 or in the 3.2.R area

blocks.zh: Module 5 中特別提到 Comparative bioequivalence study（比較性生體等效性試驗），這是因為 PFS 的遞送效能 (delivery performance) 可能影響藥品的生體可用率 (bioavailability)
blocks.en: Module 5 specifically mentions a comparative bioequivalence study, because the delivery performance of a PFS can affect the bioavailability of the drug

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 PFS 組合產品的器材資訊不能只集中放在某一個 Module？這對審查官有何影響？
blocks.en: Why can the device information for a PFS combination product not be concentrated in a single Module? What does this mean for the reviewer?

blocks.zh: 如果器材製造商不願意向藥品申請人公開完整設計細節，eCTD 中有何機制可以處理？
blocks.en: If the device manufacturer is unwilling to disclose the full design details to the drug applicant, what mechanism does the eCTD offer to handle this?

blocks.zh: 16.0 Appendix II: Module 3 for Electronic Common Technical Document (eCTD) Submission Overview 16.0 附錄 II：電子通用技術文件（eCTD）提交模組 3 概述
blocks.en: 16.0 Appendix II: Module 3 for Electronic Common Technical Document (eCTD) Submission Overview

blocks.zh: Module 3 的 P 節 (Drug Product Section)：這是 CTD 品質模組中專門描述藥品成品的區塊。對於 PFS 組合產品，器材資訊被「嵌入」到原本為藥品設計的架構中，形成藥品 + 器材的整合文件。
blocks.en: Section P of Module 3 (Drug Product): This is the part of the CTD quality module dedicated to describing the finished drug product. For a PFS combination product, the device information is "embedded" into a structure originally designed for the drug, creating an integrated drug-plus-device document.

blocks.zh: 3.2.R (Regional Information)：這是一個特殊區域，用於放置各地區特有的法規要求文件。美國放 510(k) 等級的器材審查資料，歐盟放 Technical File。這意味著同一份 eCTD 在不同國家送審時，3.2.R 的內容可能完全不同。
blocks.en: 3.2.R (Regional Information): A special area for documents that meet region-specific regulatory requirements. The US places 510(k)-level device review data here, and the EU places the Technical File. This means the content of 3.2.R in the same eCTD can be completely different depending on the country of submission.

blocks.zh: CCI (Container Closure Integrity，容器密封完整性)：確認藥品容器在整個架儲期 (shelf life) 內維持無菌屏障的能力，是 PFS 最關鍵的品質要素之一。
blocks.en: CCI (Container Closure Integrity): The ability of the drug container to maintain its sterile barrier throughout the shelf life; it is one of the most critical quality attributes of a PFS.

blocks.zh: Module 3 的結構就像一棟大型百貨公司的樓層配置。原本每一層（P.1 產品描述、P.2 開發、P.3 製造、P.5 規格、P.7 容器、P.8 安定性）都是為「藥品」這個主要租戶設計的。現在 PFS 組合產品就像一個「跨界租戶」，需要在每一層都加設一個器材專櫃。而 3.2.R 則像百貨公司的「在地化專區」，在美國設美式專櫃 (510(k))，在歐洲設歐式專櫃 (Technical File)。
blocks.en: The structure of Module 3 is like the floor plan of a large department store. Originally every floor (P.1 description, P.2 development, P.3 manufacture, P.5 specifications, P.7 container, P.8 stability) was designed for one main tenant, the "drug". Now the PFS combination product is a "crossover tenant" that needs a device counter on every floor. 3.2.R is like the store's "localization zone": an American counter (510(k)) in the US and a European counter (Technical File) in Europe.

blocks.zh: 3.2.P.2.4 是器材資訊量最大的子節 — 需涵蓋遞送準確性、人因工程、生物相容性 (ISO 10993)、元件老化等
blocks.en: 3.2.P.2.4 is the subsection with the largest volume of device information; it must cover delivery accuracy, human factors engineering, biocompatibility (ISO 10993), component aging, and so on

blocks.zh: 3.2.P.3.3 明確指出只描述「最終組裝步驟」，不描述元件製造細節（如射出成型）。這是保護器材供應商智慧財產權的設計
blocks.en: 3.2.P.3.3 states explicitly that only the "final assembly steps" are described, not the details of component manufacture (such as injection molding). This is designed to protect the intellectual property of the device supplier

blocks.zh: 3.2.P.3.4 區分「整合型組合產品 (integral)」與「套件型 (kit)」— 套件型不需要此節
blocks.en: 3.2.P.3.4 distinguishes "integral combination products" from "kits"; kits do not need this section

blocks.zh: IQ/OQ/PQ 是確效三階段：安裝確效、操作確效、性能確效，這是製藥與器材製造共通的確效方法論
blocks.en: IQ/OQ/PQ are the three stages of validation: installation qualification, operational qualification and performance qualification. This is a validation methodology common to pharmaceutical and device manufacturing

blocks.zh: Gauge R&R（量測系統的重複性與再現性分析）在器材檢驗中特別重要，因為許多器材測試涉及力學量測
blocks.en: Gauge R&R (repeatability and reproducibility analysis of a measurement system) is particularly important in device testing because many device tests involve mechanical measurements

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 當 CDMO 接受委託製造 PFS 組合產品時，必須理解自己在 eCTD 中的角色定位。例如：
blocks.en: When a CDMO accepts a contract to manufacture a PFS combination product, it must understand its role within the eCTD. For example:

blocks.zh: 填充製造商的資訊主要出現在 3.2.P.3（製造流程）和 3.2.P.5（規格與批次分析）
blocks.en: Information on the filling manufacturer appears mainly in 3.2.P.3 (manufacturing process) and 3.2.P.5 (specifications and batch analyses)

blocks.zh: 注射器供應商的資訊由 MAF 或 3.2.R 涵蓋
blocks.en: Information on the syringe supplier is covered by the MAF or by 3.2.R

blocks.zh: 安定性測試資料 (3.2.P.8) 需要藥品端和器材端的雙重數據
blocks.en: Stability data (3.2.P.8) require data from both the drug side and the device side

blocks.zh: 為什麼 3.2.P.5.1（規格）明確指出「不要包含器材元件的設計規格」？這與 3.2.P.5.6 的「設計輸入」有何區別？
blocks.en: Why does 3.2.P.5.1 (Specification) explicitly say "do not include design specifications of the device components"? How does this differ from the "design inputs" in 3.2.P.5.6?

blocks.zh: 如果一個 PFS 產品同時要在美國和歐盟申請上市，Module 3 中哪些節的內容可能需要因地區而調整？
blocks.en: If a PFS product is to be submitted for marketing authorization in both the US and the EU, which sections of Module 3 may need to be adjusted by region?

blocks.zh: 3.2.P.2.5 提到的 CCI 維持確認，在實務上需要做哪些類型的測試？
blocks.en: The maintenance of CCI mentioned in 3.2.P.2.5 requires which types of testing in practice?

blocks.zh: 17.0 Appendix III: Tests, Standards, and Guidance Documents for PFS Combination Products 17.0 附錄 III：PFS 組合產品之測試、標準與指引文件
blocks.en: 17.0 Appendix III: Tests, Standards, and Guidance Documents for PFS Combination Products

blocks.zh: 本附錄是 PFS 組合產品法規合規的「測試標準地圖」，將所有相關測試按四大類別組織：
blocks.en: This appendix is the "test standards map" for regulatory compliance of PFS combination products. It organizes all relevant tests into four categories:

blocks.zh: Protection（保護性）：確保容器密封系統 (Container Closure System) 在架儲期內保護藥品不受外界因素降解。核心測試為無菌性 (Sterility) 和滅菌確效 (Sterilization Validation)
blocks.en: Protection: Ensures that the container closure system protects the drug from degradation by external factors throughout the shelf life. The core tests are sterility and sterilization validation

blocks.zh: Safety（安全性）：確保包裝材料不會釋出有害物質。涵蓋玻璃、彈性體 (Elastomer)、針頭的材料安全測試，以及 ISO 10993 生物相容性系列
blocks.en: Safety: Ensures that packaging materials do not release harmful substances. It covers material safety tests for glass, elastomer and needles, as well as the ISO 10993 biocompatibility series

blocks.zh: Compatibility（相容性）：確保藥品與容器不會發生不可接受的交互作用。核心為 Extractables & Leachables (E&L) 測試
blocks.en: Compatibility: Ensures that no unacceptable interaction occurs between the drug and the container. The core is Extractables & Leachables (E&L) testing

blocks.zh: Performance（效能）：確保系統能按設計功能運作、精確遞送標示劑量
blocks.en: Performance: Ensures that the system operates as designed and accurately delivers the labeled dose

blocks.zh: 這張測試標準總表就像一張「PFS 健檢項目清單」。就像人體健檢分為基本理學檢查（保護性）、血液毒物篩檢（安全性）、過敏原檢測（相容性）、體能測試（效能）一樣，每個 PFS 元件都需要依據自身角色接受相應的「體檢」。組裝完成的注射器還需要通過「全身綜合檢查」。
blocks.en: This master table of test standards is like a "PFS health check-up list". Just as a human check-up is divided into a basic physical examination (Protection), blood toxicology screening (Safety), allergen testing (Compatibility) and a fitness test (Performance), each PFS component needs the appropriate "check-up" for its own role. The assembled syringe also has to pass a "full-body comprehensive examination".

blocks.zh: ISO 11040 系列是 PFS 最核心的專用標準：-4 適用於玻璃注射器筒，-5 適用於活塞膠塞
blocks.en: The ISO 11040 series is the core PFS-specific standard: -4 applies to glass syringe barrels and -5 to plunger stoppers

blocks.zh: ISO 11135（環氧乙烷滅菌）和 ISO 11137（輻射滅菌）是 PFS 元件最常用的兩種滅菌方法標準
blocks.en: ISO 11135 (ethylene oxide sterilization) and ISO 11137 (radiation sterilization) are the two sterilization method standards most commonly used for PFS components

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 820（品質系統規範，QSR）是美國 FDA 對醫療器材的 GMP 要求，而 21 CFR 210/211 是藥品 cGMP — PFS 組合產品需同時符合兩套品質系統
blocks.en: 21 CFR 820 (Quality System Regulation, QSR) is the FDA GMP requirement for medical devices, while 21 CFR 210/211 is the drug cGMP; a PFS combination product must comply with both quality systems

blocks.zh: EN ISO 13485 是歐洲醫療器材品質管理系統標準，EN ISO 14971 是風險管理標準 — 兩者都是歐盟 CE 標誌的基礎
blocks.en: EN ISO 13485 is the European quality management system standard for medical devices and EN ISO 14971 is the risk management standard; both underpin the EU CE mark

blocks.zh: Needlestick Safety and Prevention Act（防針扎安全法案）反映了對醫護人員職業安全的法律要求，與 ISO 23908（尖銳物防護功能）相呼應
blocks.en: The Needlestick Safety and Prevention Act reflects the legal requirement for occupational safety of healthcare workers and corresponds to ISO 23908 (sharps injury protection features)

blocks.zh: USP <87>/<88>（體外/體內生物反應性測試）與 ISO 10993 構成生物相容性評估的雙軌體系
blocks.en: USP <87>/<88> (in vitro/in vivo biological reactivity tests) and ISO 10993 form a two-track system for biocompatibility assessment

blocks.zh: 品質系統雙軌制 Dual Quality System
blocks.en: Dual Quality System

blocks.zh: PFS 組合產品的最大法規挑戰在於需要同時滿足藥品 GMP 和器材 QSR 兩套品質系統要求。在實務中，這意味著：
blocks.en: The greatest regulatory challenge for a PFS combination product is having to meet the requirements of two quality systems at the same time: drug GMP and device QSR. In practice, this means:

blocks.zh: 變更管控 (Change Control) 需同時考慮藥品和器材的影響評估
blocks.en: Change control must consider the impact assessment for both the drug and the device

blocks.zh: 供應商管理需覆蓋藥品原料供應商和器材元件供應商
blocks.en: Supplier management must cover both drug raw material suppliers and device component suppliers

blocks.zh: 驗證策略需整合 ICH Q8/Q9/Q10（藥品端）與 ISO 13485/14971（器材端）
blocks.en: The validation strategy must integrate ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 (drug side) with ISO 13485/14971 (device side)

blocks.zh: 假設你是一家 CDMO，接到客戶委託製造一款生物製劑 PFS 產品。在規劃品質管制實驗室的測試能力時，你需要確認以下能力：
blocks.en: Suppose you are a CDMO that has been commissioned by a client to manufacture a biologic PFS product. When planning the testing capabilities of the quality control laboratory, you need to confirm the following capabilities:

blocks.zh: CCI 測試 (USP <1207>, ASTM F2338) — 如氦氣洩漏法或高壓放電法
blocks.en: CCI testing (USP <1207>, ASTM F2338), such as helium leak or high-voltage leak detection

blocks.zh: E&L 分析能力 — 需要 GC-MS, LC-MS, ICP-MS 等精密分析儀器
blocks.en: E&L analytical capability: requires sophisticated instruments such as GC-MS, LC-MS and ICP-MS

blocks.zh: 功能測試 — 滑動力、破裂力 (break-loose force)、注射力等力學測試
blocks.en: Functional testing: mechanical tests such as glide force, break-loose force and injection force

blocks.zh: 運輸模擬 (ASTM D4169, ISTA 3E) — 跌落、振動、壓縮等包裝運輸確效
blocks.en: Transportation simulation (ASTM D4169, ISTA 3E): shipping validation of the package through drop, vibration and compression testing

blocks.zh: 為什麼 E&L 測試需要對每個元件（活塞膠塞、針頭、護套）都進行，而不僅僅是對組裝後的注射器整體測試？
blocks.en: Why must E&L testing be performed on each component (plunger stopper, needle, needle shield) and not only on the assembled syringe as a whole?

blocks.zh: ISO 10993 和 USP <87>/<88> 都涉及生物相容性，這兩套標準體系在適用範圍上有何差異？
blocks.en: Both ISO 10993 and USP <87>/<88> deal with biocompatibility. How do the scopes of these two standard systems differ?

blocks.zh: 包裝運輸測試 (ASTM D 系列) 為什麼特別列在 PFS 的測試項目中？與一般藥品的運輸確效有何不同？
blocks.en: Why are packaging transportation tests (the ASTM D series) specifically listed among the PFS test items? How do they differ from shipping validation for ordinary drug products?

blocks.zh: 18.0 Appendix IV: Compound Classification with the Associated Threshold of Toxicological Concern (TTC) 18.0 附錄 IV：化合物分類與相關毒理關注閾值（TTC）
blocks.en: 18.0 Appendix IV: Compound Classification with the Associated Threshold of Toxicological Concern (TTC)

blocks.zh: TTC (Threshold of Toxicological Concern，毒理學關注閾值)：這是一種基於化合物結構的風險評估方法，為那些毒理資料不完整的溶出物 (Leachables) 提供安全限值。核心邏輯是：化學結構越複雜、越缺乏安全數據，允許的每日暴露量就越低。
blocks.en: TTC (Threshold of Toxicological Concern): A structure-based risk assessment approach that provides safe limits for leachables with incomplete toxicological data. The core logic is that the more complex the chemical structure and the less safety data available, the lower the permitted daily exposure.

blocks.zh: PQRI-PODP (Product Quality Research Institute - Parenteral and Ophthalmic Drug Products)：這是美國產品品質研究機構中專門針對注射劑和眼用製劑包材的工作小組，負責建立 E&L 評估的閾值框架。
blocks.en: PQRI-PODP (Product Quality Research Institute - Parenteral and Ophthalmic Drug Products): The PQRI working group dedicated to packaging materials for parenteral and ophthalmic drug products, responsible for establishing the threshold framework for E&L evaluation.

blocks.zh: Cramer Classification（Cramer 分類）：由 Cramer, Ford & Hall (1978) 提出的決策樹分類法，根據化學結構將化合物分為三個毒性風險等級。本表在此基礎上增加了 Class IV 和 Class V，涵蓋更嚴重的毒理學端點。
blocks.en: Cramer Classification: A decision-tree classification proposed by Cramer, Ford & Hall (1978) that assigns compounds to three toxicity risk levels according to chemical structure. This table builds on it by adding Class IV and Class V, which cover more serious toxicological endpoints.

blocks.zh: TTC 分類系統就像交通法規的速限分區：住宅區（Class V，極危險物質）速限最低（1.5 μg/day），因為風險最高；鄉間道路（Class I，低風險物質）速限最高（150 μg/day），因為相對安全。越危險的路段，允許的「通過量」就越少。
blocks.en: The TTC classification system is like speed-limit zones in traffic regulations: the residential zone (Class V, extremely hazardous substances) has the lowest speed limit (1.5 μg/day) because the risk is highest, while the country road (Class I, low-risk substances) has the highest limit (150 μg/day) because it is comparatively safe. The more dangerous the road section, the less "throughput" is allowed.

blocks.zh: TTC 閾值層級對照
blocks.en: TTC Threshold Levels

blocks.zh:
Class I  (低風險):    150 μg/day  ── 基準值
Class II (中風險):     45 μg/day  ── 約 Class I 的 30%
Class III(高風險):    7.5 μg/day  ── 約 Class I 的 5%
Class IV (致敏/致畸):   5 μg/day  ── 約 Class I 的 3.3%
Class V  (基因毒性):  1.5 μg/day  ── 約 Class I 的 1%

從 Class I 到 Class V，TTC 下降 100 倍！
blocks.en:
Class I  (low risk):    150 μg/day  -- baseline
Class II (medium risk):  45 μg/day  -- about 30% of Class I
Class III (high risk):  7.5 μg/day  -- about 5% of Class I
Class IV (sensitizing/teratogenic): 5 μg/day  -- about 3.3% of Class I
Class V  (genotoxic):   1.5 μg/day  -- about 1% of Class I

From Class I to Class V, the TTC drops 100-fold!

blocks.zh: Class III 的附帶條件非常重要：只有在該化合物不觸發致敏、刺激、基因毒性、致突變、致癌、致畸等毒理學警報時，才適用 7.5 μg/day 的閾值。一旦觸發這些警報，就自動升級為 Class IV 或 Class V
blocks.en: The proviso for Class III is very important: the 7.5 μg/day threshold applies only if the compound does not trigger toxicological alerts for sensitization, irritation, genotoxicity, mutagenicity, carcinogenicity, teratogenicity and so on. Once such alerts are triggered, the compound is automatically upgraded to Class IV or Class V

blocks.zh: DEHP (鄰苯二甲酸二(2-乙基己基)酯) 和 Bisphenol A (雙酚A) 是包裝材料中最常見的高關注物質 (SVHC)，屬於 Class V 管控。PFS 中的彈性體膠塞和潤滑劑是 DEHP 的潛在來源
blocks.en: DEHP (di(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate) and Bisphenol A are the most common substances of very high concern (SVHC) in packaging materials and are controlled as Class V. The elastomeric stopper and the lubricant in a PFS are potential sources of DEHP

blocks.zh: 這些 TTC 值是基於口服毒性資料推導的，對於注射劑途徑，實際安全限值可能需要進一步調低（考慮注射途徑的 100% 生體可用率）
blocks.en: These TTC values are derived from oral toxicity data. For the injection route, the actual safe limit may need to be lowered further (considering 100% bioavailability by injection)

blocks.zh: 當某個溶出物的檢測量超過其對應 Class 的 TTC 時，必須進行專門的毒理學評估 (Toxicological Risk Assessment) 來判斷是否可接受
blocks.en: When the measured amount of a leachable exceeds the TTC of its corresponding Class, a dedicated toxicological risk assessment must be performed to determine whether it is acceptable

blocks.zh: 在 PFS 開發過程中，E&L 評估的典型工作流程為：
blocks.en: The typical workflow for E&L evaluation during PFS development is:

blocks.zh: 可萃取物研究 (Extractables Study)：使用模擬溶劑在加速條件下萃取各元件，以 GC-MS 和 LC-MS 鑑定化合物
blocks.en: Extractables study: Extract each component with simulating solvents under accelerated conditions and identify the compounds by GC-MS and LC-MS

blocks.zh: 化合物分類：對每個鑑定出的化合物，依據 Cramer 決策樹和結構警報進行 Class I-V 分類
blocks.en: Compound classification: Classify each identified compound into Class I-V based on the Cramer decision tree and structural alerts

blocks.zh: TTC 比對：將每個化合物的預估每日暴露量與其 Class 對應的 TTC 比較
blocks.en: TTC comparison: Compare the estimated daily exposure of each compound with the TTC for its Class

blocks.zh: 風險判定：暴露量 < TTC 者可視為低風險；暴露量 > TTC 者需進行專案毒理評估
blocks.en: Risk determination: Exposure < TTC can be regarded as low risk; exposure > TTC requires a case-specific toxicological assessment

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TTC 體系在 PFS 中特別重要？與傳統西林瓶 (vial) 相比，PFS 有哪些額外的 E&L 風險源？
blocks.en: Why is the TTC framework particularly important for PFS? Compared with a traditional vial, what additional E&L risk sources does a PFS have?

blocks.zh: 如果一個溶出物被歸類為 Cramer Class III，但經過結構分析發現它具有致敏性警報，應該如何處理？
blocks.en: If a leachable is classified as Cramer Class III but structural analysis shows that it carries a sensitization alert, how should it be handled?

blocks.zh: 注射途徑的 TTC 是否需要比口服途徑更嚴格？為什麼？
blocks.en: Does the TTC for the injection route need to be stricter than for the oral route? Why?

blocks.zh: TR73 整體報告總結 Overall Report Summary
blocks.en: Overall Report Summary: TR73

blocks.zh: PFS 是藥品-器材組合產品：預填充式注射器同時具備藥品容器和遞送器材的雙重角色，必須在設計、開發、製造、法規送審的每個階段整合藥品和器材兩個領域的要求
blocks.en: A PFS is a drug-device combination product: The prefilled syringe serves both as a drug container and as a delivery device, so the requirements of both the drug and device fields must be integrated at every stage of design, development, manufacture and regulatory submission

blocks.zh: eCTD 送審的跨模組整合：附錄 I-II 清楚展示了 PFS 資訊如何分散在 CTD 的多個 Module 和子節中。特別是 Module 3 中的 3.2.P 各節和 3.2.R 區域，是組合產品品質文件的核心架構
blocks.en: Cross-module integration in eCTD submissions: Appendices I-II show clearly how PFS information is spread across multiple CTD Modules and subsections. The 3.2.P sections and the 3.2.R area in Module 3 in particular form the core structure of the quality documentation for a combination product

blocks.zh: 測試標準的四維框架：附錄 III 建立了以 Protection（保護）、Safety（安全）、Compatibility（相容性）、Performance（效能）為四大支柱的完整測試體系，每個 PFS 元件都有對應的 ISO、USP、FDA 標準
blocks.en: A four-dimensional framework for test standards: Appendix III establishes a complete testing system built on four pillars: Protection, Safety, Compatibility and Performance, with corresponding ISO, USP and FDA standards for every PFS component

blocks.zh: E&L 的風險分級管理：附錄 IV 的 TTC 五級分類（Class I-V，150 至 1.5 μg/day）為可萃取物和溶出物的安全評估提供了系統化的判定標準
blocks.en: Risk-based management of E&L: The five-class TTC system in Appendix IV (Class I-V, 150 to 1.5 μg/day) provides a systematic basis for the safety assessment of extractables and leachables

blocks.zh: 品質系統的雙軌並行：PFS 組合產品需同時遵循藥品 cGMP (21 CFR 210/211) 和器材 QSR (21 CFR 820) / ISO 13485，以及風險管理 (ICH Q9 / ISO 14971) 的雙重要求
blocks.en: Two quality systems in parallel: A PFS combination product must comply with both the drug cGMP (21 CFR 210/211) and the device QSR (21 CFR 820) / ISO 13485, as well as the risk management requirements (ICH Q9 / ISO 14971) of both

blocks.zh: 患者安全是最高優先：從容器密封完整性 (CCI) 到生物相容性 (ISO 10993)，從滅菌確效到功能性測試，所有法規要求的最終目標都是確保患者安全和藥品品質
blocks.en: Patient safety is the top priority: From container closure integrity (CCI) to biocompatibility (ISO 10993), and from sterilization validation to functional testing, the ultimate goal of all regulatory requirements is to ensure patient safety and drug quality
